encoding.layout: 8-bit greyscale, 4 * size wide: R0 G0 B0 A0 R1 ... per row
encoding.r: park * 64 + walk * 8 + road (surface ids, parking kinds)
encoding.g: way bearing (a field's long axis on arable land): 0 unknown, else 1 + bearing (from east, ccw) over 0..360 deg
encoding.ba: along-street offset mod 165.0 m, 13 bits, low byte first: along = offset + (x - west, y - north) . (cos, sin)(bearing); A bits 5-6 the street parking's place, bit 7 its bays painted
